notes: The schematic image was not available, so the wiring is derived from the text: I2S mic on A6 (SD), 2 (SCK), 3 (FS/WS); DC motor driven by an N-MOSFET with a 2.2k pull-down on the gate and a flyback diode across the motor; servo signal through an N-MOSFET level shifter (gate to 3.3V, 2.2k pull-up to 5V); 0.1uF and 100uF capacitors across 5V/GND.
The MKR Zero pins for the motor MOSFET gate (4) and servo signal (5) are assumptions; the manual does not state them.
The MKR Zero 3.3V pin is the 'VCC' port in the catalogue; the mic VDD and the level-shifter gate use it. 5V comes from the 5V pin (USB powered).
The N-MOSFETs in the photo are TO-220 parts; the catalogue 2n7000 type is used as the nearest N-channel MOSFET. Pin order on the breadboard is assumed.
ICS43432 L/R pin is tied to GND (assumed). Microphone is assumed placed on the breadboard (breakout with 6 pins).

The motor and servo wires are shown as jumper wires between the component terminals and the breadboard. The 'rubber-band' part is not in the catalogue and is not given a draft type; it only contacts the wheel on the DC motor. The laser-cut MDF box, wheel, lifting arm and card stock are mechanical and not modelled.

Medium breadboard used as in the text although the diagram uses a full-size board; hole positions are my own layout. Resistor value 2200 ohms; capacitor c2 is 100uF using the capacitor-10uf type with a value prop.
